author: claude
summary: Task 009 of the voice-variant-tagging-and-ia plan: rewrites VariantsSection.tsx from 'map every profile to a stacked VariantEditor' into 'render VariantSwitcher (task 008) + exactly ONE VariantEditor for the selected variant' (fixes the root finding every reviewer converged on, DC-001/DC-005). VariantsSection now owns selectedVariantName state, defaulting to is_variant_default then profiles[0], auto-selecting newly-added variants and falling back sensibly when the selected variant disappears (pattern reimplemented from the retired NarratorCard.tsx, not reused directly). Demoted VariantEditor's always-visible footer (Move/Delete) and header (Script/Rebuild-or-Generate) chrome into a single ActionMenu overflow trigger; Play, speed, and performance_tags chips remain always-visible outside it.

files.change: Rewritten: renders VariantSwitcher + exactly one VariantEditor (keyed by selectedProfile.name) instead of one VariantEditor per profile. Added selectedVariantName state with two effects: auto-select newly added variants, and fall back to is_variant_default/profiles[0] when the current selection disappears or profiles start non-empty. handleSetDefault POSTs to /api/speaker-profiles/{name}/variants/{variant}/set-default (task 005's endpoint) then onRefresh().

Chrome demotion: replaced the always-visible footer (Move Variant/Delete Variant) and header Script/Rebuild-or-Generate buttons with a single ActionMenu (MoreVertical trigger, title="More actions") whose items are Script, Rebuild-or-Generate (same enabled/disabled logic as before, not gated on is_rebuild_required), a divider, Move Variant, and Delete Variant (isDestructive, still routes through requestConfirm). No tooltip/title text carried over onto menu items (ActionMenuItem has no title field) — a deliberate, flagged trade-off vs. the previous per-button title copy.

Replaced the old 'renders one VariantEditor row per profile' assertion (counted Script buttons) with 'renders VariantSwitcher plus exactly ONE VariantEditor' (counts tabs vs. 'More actions' triggers) and added a selection-default/tab-switch test.

Added an ActionMenu-mock-based describe block (same pattern as ProjectCard.test.tsx) asserting Script/Rebuild/Move Variant/Delete Variant items exist, are wired to the same handlers as before, and Delete still routes through requestConfirm.
Updated two real-wiring tests to open the ActionMenu ('More actions') before clicking Rebuild, since it's no longer a directly-visible button.
Updated the Script-click-switches-to-Test-tab test to open the ActionMenu first.
Updated the imported-variant-label NarratorCard/VariantEditor/ScriptEditor integration test to open the ActionMenu before clicking Script.

Updated 6 NarratorCard/VariantEditor tests that asserted always-visible Rebuild/Generate/Script/Move/Delete buttons or their title attributes; now open the relevant ActionMenu (NarratorCard has its own card-level ActionMenu at index 0, VariantEditor's chrome-demoted one is index 1 when the card is expanded) and assert on menu item presence/label/disabled state instead of button titles (which the ActionMenu items don't carry).
